title: 🔴 THE RANDOM FLIGHT CHALLENGE! ✈️ (Where are we going?)
description:
The wheel decides. The bot selects. We just fly.

Welcome to tonight's Random Flight Challenge! We’re letting the community bot and the spin-wheel take total control of our flight plan. We could be flying a TBM over the Alps or an A320 into a stormy tropical island—I won't know until we're on the tarmac.

Tonight’s Rules:

🎰 The Wheel: Determines our aircraft and weather conditions.
🤖 The Bot: Picks our random departure and arrival cities at 16:00 CET.
🛫 The Goal: Stick the landing, no matter where we end up.

Join the Community:

💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/J3tZyhceUM - Join the "Bot-Select" channel to see the results early!
✈️ Sim: Microsoft Flight Simulator (2024)
